brief: Copy of an array with values removed and/or inserted
description: Return a new array that is array with the changes splice would make, leaving array unchanged: deleteCount values removed at startIndex and values inserted there. Negative startIndex counts from the end. If deleteCount is omitted, all values from startIndex to the end are removed.

parameters.description: Zero-based start index, or negative from the end.
parameters.name: startIndex

parameters.description: Number of values to remove. If omitted, remove through the end of the array. Negative is treated as zero.
parameters.name: deleteCount

parameters.description: Values to insert at startIndex after removals.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: A new array with the changes made.
